title: Innovative Prosthetics Positively Change the Paralympics
summary: The World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) highlights how innovative prosthetic technologies are enhancing performance and participation in Paralympic sports, showcasing advancements in disability assistive technology.
body:
The World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) highlights how innovative prosthetic technologies are enhancing performance and participation in Paralympic sports, showcasing advancements in disability assistive technology.
